author: heRAH
body:
Age: 15

Timezone: PST

Do you have Teamspeak? No, but might get it

Do you have Discord? Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? No



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? Yes on a small SG server


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating? Being toxic, but it's rare. Can't really see my self being it if I am a high rank such as JrMod


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not? A leader must be confident, a helpful hand, someone people can look up to for help. Am I a leader? Sort of I like to think of myself as someone people can ask questions and stuff like that


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? I have been playing this server for 3 years now so I know a thing or two about the server and how it's run.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? What skills you need is level-headed you can't be bias towards someone on the server even if their your friend. And friendly. No one likes someone who is a nuisance. Do I have these skills? In my opinion yes.


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating? As I said before, a level-head, friendliness, someone people can look up to for questions for anything going on in the server.



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do? First talk to said moderator and ask them about it. And if they don't really give me a answer I would go to a higher authority.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? Tell the players that they can dislike a staff member, but there is no need to be racially insulting to the staff member.



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? Ask them why only staff can see it.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do? Ask the senior staff to stop harassing the players if they show anger. And say your not senior staff just to abuse players.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator? Because I have been playing this server for very long and I think it would be cool if i could help the server out.


What does Avicus mean to you? A fun server that I can come to hang out with frineds or just other players.


Anything specific the staff team could do better? Not that I can think of. I don't know much of the current staff right now.


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus? It is one of my favorite servers that I have been playing on for a while/


Do you have anything else to add to your application? It doesn't reall y have to do with the application, just is Quintis still a map? xD
